action: Say yes to Denise Williams. Text her: I can do thirty minutes this week — Wednesday afternoon or Thursday morning, whichever works for you. I will tell her what the community college process actually looks like, what the grant application requires, and what the realistic timeline is to an income-generating credential from a standing start. In exchange I want to hear one thing from her: how is she reading the pace of change in transport infrastructure from where she sits? She manages a parking garage. She sees the flow of vehicles, the utilization patterns, the conversations with operators. That is ground-level intelligence I do not have.
